newsitem.title: USA: Lockheed deal values Northrop at $121.50/shr.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed deal values Northrop at $121.50/shr.

text.p: The proposed union of Lockheed Martin Corp and Northrop Grumman Corp values Northrop Grumman at about $121.50 per share, based on early stock activity.
The stock transaction calls for holders of Northrop Grumman to receive 1.1923 shares of Lockheed Martin common stock for each share of Northrop held.

Wall Street traders said the deal is likely to generate intense scrutiny among federal regulators, who this week quashed the proposed $4.6 billion merger of Staples Inc and Office Depot Inc on antitrust grounds.
"I think it is going to have a very difficult time. It's going to be a long road," said one arbitrageur.
Shares of Northrop Grumman soared 25-1/8 to 114 per share, staying below the offer price. Stock of Lockheed Martin fell 2-3/8 to 101-5/8.
